posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I'll drink either if they're decaf, but I'd rather have latte than cappuccino and my tea of choice is Earl Grey, hot.

Hot chocolate always sounds (and smells) so good, but enviably disappoints me for no reason I can work out. I always regret drinking it straight away afterwards and wish I'd picked something else. And I LOVE chocolate, so it doesn't make sense.

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
Green tea is probably my favourite tea, hot or iced. We burn through roughly a gallon every two days of our brewed black iced tea, the husband and I. As for coffee, I prefer the beverages that add more and more milk, so latte is best, I guess. Add in caramel and I'm forever yours!

 

one thing we had recently in Philadelphia was a brown sugar coffee, which was naturally delicious. Beyond that, cocoa is a delight and only occasionally disappoints.

 

In short, I have a gambling problem and London Fog is best hot beverage.

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
New day, new question!

 

Hit the snooze button or wake up?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Wake up. I set my alarm at the latest possible time for me to where I must get up to be able to leave on time without goofing around. So hitting the snooze would put me at 9 minutes behind schedule.

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked: Hit the snooze button exactly twice. (The snooze on my phone is only 5 min).

posts.name: bobbertoriley
posts.cooked: Snooze on weekdays, get up without snooze on weekend (although I sleep in 2 hours later on the weekend)

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked: Don't set the alarm in the frst place!

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
New day, new question!

Shower in the morning or at night?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Depends on the day. Mon-thurs is typically morning showering. Saturday is evening.

posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked: Night! Then I can go to bed clean. And don’t take as much time getting ready in the morning.

posts.name: dprcooke
posts.cooked:
Every morning because without a shower I can’t wake up.

But also frequently in the evening because I play ultimate 3-4 nights a week and don’t want to go to bed stinky and gross.

posts.name: Melanie_Shaman
posts.cooked: Wake up, I don't trust myself to hit the snooze button. My exwife used to hit the snooze over and over and over, it drove me nuts.

New day, new question:

Different type of question today. You have the power to create realistic illusions. How would you use this power to help other (besides fighting crime)?

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: I would create a dogs for everyone! Since their illusions they don’t need to eat nor will they poop!

posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
New day, new question!

Pick one to lose completely, and one to enhance to super-human levels:

1) Sense of Smell

2) Sense of Humor

3) Sense of Direction

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: Lose sense of smell and gain an extraordinary sense of direction.   Currently my sense of smell isn’t great anyways and often I have no good sense of direction so it would be positive entirely for me.

posts.name: Melanie_Shaman
posts.cooked: I already have no sense of smell, but I'll certainly take the sense of direction.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
I also have no sense of smell (literally none), so it's easy to pick what to lose, my sense of humor. I have no need to know exactly what the balance between my 4 humors is at any given moment, that quackery having been replaced with actual ducks long ago.

As you can tell from above I already have superhuman levels of Humour, and I can always tell which way is forward so I'm not sure a Sense of Direction would be great for me either.... hmmm.
